Wavee themes · 1 of 4 · the default theme

Wavee Classic, tuned

Classic is the app people run today: Mica shell, the sidebar, the content card, tabs in the title bar, the one-row player bar, colour washes and the production motion. It is not a redesign. This board lists every change the theme makes to today’s app: bugs it fixes, gaps it fills, and the owner-approved decisions that are not on main yet (PR 205). Everything else stays exactly as production draws it.

Fix: a bug on main Gap: a missing state, now drawn Decided: owner-approved, not on main yet Owner check: changes a recognisable trait
No layout jumps
Every new state reserves its height (InfoBars, facts, badges, skeletons) or animates its height. Nothing pushes content.
Production motion is kept
Page swap 90 / 90 / 210, the artist photo arriving after the copy, Home zone rises: unchanged. Fixes only make them render on time.
No feature is switched off
Pinned de-dup, washes, marquee, row styles, Liked covers and the artist bleed (Zune) all stay; a fix repairs them. The one hide (#199) is the owner’s own call.

What deliberately stays (Classic identity)

The WinUI audit flags some of these as Fluent breaks. In Classic they are the look, so they stay exactly as production draws them.

Left out on purpose

  • Zune-only work (artist full bleed, pivot band, row 2, D-3, D-8): it belongs to the Zune theme, not Classic.
  • Purely behavioural bugs with no drawable change: title-bar hit regions after a switch (G2), the first click lost in the hidden scrollbar lane (D2), FLIP capture order, audio lag (#113). They still get fixed, in core or the engine.
  • New features asked for in issues: custom palettes (#184, a future theme option), waveform timecode (#154), mixes (#48), a mini player (#197 follow-up).
  • Sortable column headers (WinUI audit §7): a feature, not a fix; the Sort menu covers it.
